lines.english: "I'll be going, then."
"Listen, you better not break our promise, okay?"
"I got it. I'll make sure to be back by ten."
"Just for today, you can't go out with anyone for a drink even if they insist, okay?"
"No, I doubt anyone would ask a married man out today."
"Even if some special scoop pops up late tonight, don't go running off to cover it.
"…! I'll do my best."
"Promise me. If you don't come back today, I'll go back home to my family."
"Uum… Fine. I promise to come back."
"Then off you go, Darling."
"Yeah… I'm heading out."
After our longer-than-usual parting, Setsuna kisses me lightly on the lips as she usually does.
Setsuna's being a lot more particular than she usually is today. She's also become her unreasonably spoiled self, in a way.
…But I suppose that's to be expected. And no, I'm not saying this because I'm her husband.
Setsuna only acts like this three times a year.
The first time she behaves like this is on February 14thーher birthday. That she would behave in such a spoiled manner on that occasion is only natural.
The second time is during my birthday in April.
And the third time she acts like this…
Is today… December 24th. Christmas Eve.
A commemorative day where married couples and lovers fall prey to the commercialist custom of indulging in presents and dates.
But for the two of us… Well, this particular day has bound us together over many years.
It's the day we once swore eternal friendship in a hot spring up north; the day we faced our greatest crisis at a seaside hotel;
Although it's a day that's exemplified by the many sins I've committed, it also serves as a very important day of remembrance, in a sense.
That's why this is the one day I absolutely cannot break a promise with Setsuna on.
I'll meet Setsuna again today, wish her Merry Christmas, and swear to her that she's the only one for me.
"…Alright!"
With that thought in my mind, I reach my workplace with reaffirmed determination.
The unshakable vow I carry in my heart is a big departure from the usual enthusiasm I have for work.
"Kitahara, I'm done here so come check it when you can."
"Ah, take care of the layout here as well, please."
"I'll take care of both those things! …However I regret to inform you that these tasks will be my last for the day."
I catch a glimpse of the editing room clock, and find that it's already nearing 8 PM.
If I'm to keep my promise with Setsuna to see her before 10 PM, I'll have to finish things up rather quickly.
"Ah, what's up with that attitude? You have a lot of cheek for a rookie!"
"It seriously irritates me when people take that attitude with me on Christmas Eve of all days."
…Is what I'd like to say, but my two seniors seem to have a lot going on during Christmas Eve…
"What's the matter, Kitahara? Planning to sneak away so you can cozy up to your gorgeous wife for Christmas?"
"Your wife is something else, isn't she? She's famous in the industry as the public relations beauty of Knights Records.
"Perhaps he's stiff in more ways than one."
"Macchan, if I sued you for that statement, I'd be swimming in cash from the reparations you'd owe me."
"…You two, if you can afford to waste time rambling on like that, why don't you just go home?
"That's precisely the thing! Come on, I need some advice from you, Kitahara…"
"Huh? But I'm just a lowly rookie, like you said."
"But you're my superior when it comes to family! I'm begging you!"
"But what worth does my opinion have…?"
"Thing is, I'm under a lot of pressure from my girlfriend right now. If I meet her now, I'm sure I'm going to be forced to make some kind of decision."
"I doubt I can be of any help. Are you sure you should even be giving me such sensitive information?"
"She's invited me to visit her family for New Year's. This is bad, right? If I go there, it'll all be set in stone, right?"
"No, I don't see the problem with visiting her family. Besides, if you're going to be in a long-term relationship,
"But I'm not even remotely ready to take that step! I want to be single at least until I'm 30, ya know…"
"…Oh dear, half-baked men like this are a dime a dozen.
"…Suzuki-san, do you have a bug planted on me or something?"
"Besides, no one starts out with self-esteem. It's something you earn by leaving your comfort zone, trying new things and giving it your best."
Suzuki-san does make a good point.
"Ugh, you piss me off. Men who lack both courage and will should all just die!"
"Suzuki-san, did by any chance, you and your boyfriend…?"
"…Yeah, my bad. Let's end this conversation here."
But whatever good point she was making was overshadowed by the terrifying aura of bitterness from first-hand experience.
"…Since you two have all this time to sit around chit-chatting,
"I'm not accepting any further requests for today!"
"Oh, I actually have plans with my girlfriend! See you next time!"
Just as Matsuoka-san and I sprang up in unison to get away from Suzuki-san's evil aura, bags in our hands…
An ominous sound rang out through the editing department.
"…Hey, Kitahara, have you ever heard of Matsuoka's law?"
"I don't know and I don't care to know."
"This always happens to me.
"In your case, Macchan, those are simply reminders for all the work deadlines you've been neglecting."
"In any case, if I answer that phone call, I'll be here all day. I have no doubt it's work that has to be done urgently, which means I'll be better off if I…"
I doubt the contents of the call are going to change just because someone else picks up the phone.
"S-Suzuki-san…"
"Oh, I'm so terribly busy. First I get dumped by my boyfriend and now I have endless work on Christmas Eve. I simply don't have the time to answer the phone."
How can someone be busy with getting dumped?
"Fine, I'll answer it, I guess… but Matsuoka-san, don't run off."
And with a grim resolve in my heart, I pick up the phone that has been annoying us for the past minute.
"Hello, this is the Kaiou Graph editing department…"
And then…
"Yes, yes… Okay, I understand. Thank you…"
"K-Kitahara…?"
"What was it?"
"Remember that minister of construction we exposed for making illegal contributions?"
"Huh? No, wait a second…"
"This is big…"
"Apparently he sent in his resignation just earlier. There's a press conference about it starting soon."
"But we're way too understaffed right now to handle that!"
"Yup, I'll have to call up the entire editing department. We're going to need everybody's co-operation for this."
"B-But our Christmas!"
"You should be happy, Matsuoka-san! Now you have the perfect excuse to reject your girlfriend."
"He, hehe, hehehe… Looks like God has finally answered my prayers. That's right, Christmas can go die for all I care!"
Once Matsuoka's law is in effect, there is no stopping it.
…Seriously though, what am I supposed to do now?
"I'm sorry! Please forgive me!"
It was only after the bustle had settled down a bit that I was able to get in touch with Setsuna, nearly at midnight.
Christmas Eve is… no more.
"The press conference just finished. Now I'll just have to write an article about it… Um, I'll probably make it home around… 3 o'clock in the morning."
I'm not even sure if it really is Setsuna on the other end of the line.
"So, uh, could you put today's dinner in the fridge for me? I think it'd be better if you just went to sleep now, Setsuna."
After all, I haven't heard a word from the other end since I began the call.
She was only listening to my endless list of excuses… Actually, I'm not even sure if she's even listening to me.
"Haah…"
"S-Setsuna!"
The moment I was about to give up, an exasperated voice reached me from the receiver.
"I'll be going home to my family, as promised."
"Setsunaaaa!?"
…Along with the words I wanted to avoid hearing more than anything.
"…Hehe, just kidding."
"Huh…?"
"Neither of us could have predicted that a big scoop would appear that would involve the entire editing department, the seniors, and the chief editor."
"Yeah, I get that, but…"
"But at the same time, I couldn't have predicted that I'd have to go around and bow my head at every big store
"What are you talking about…?"
"They found a bug in one of the softwares we released yesterday. Thanks to that, we had to take back every single copy. Hahahaha…"
"Wait a second…"
A blunder like that is not something I'd expect Setsuna to simply laugh off…
"When it grew late, most of the stores closed, so I was only able to return to the office because I had run out of places to apologize to…
"…It sounds so tragic I can't even find the words to describe it."
"Hey, don't be so taken aback. Laughing about it is the only thing I can do now."
"Haha…"
We both promised to return home early today, only to both be met with a once-in-a-year workplace crisis…
"Hey, Haruki-kun."
"Hm?"
"Let's meet up and go home together. Call me when you're done over there."
"I might be forced to take the morning train, just so you know."
"I'm in a similar situation myself. So let's take a taxi home together instead, okay?"
"…Yeah, got it."
Is there another couple in the world that is as in sync as we are?
And now it's 3 AM.
I wrote my article, got Hamada-san to check it, and left the office exhausted, only to be met with the freezing chill of the city streets.
"Welcome back, Haruki-kun."
Despite that, Setsuna stood waiting for me in the cold without any hint of being bothered by it, all alone on the pavement.
"Were you really at work?"
"Huh, what's that supposed to mean? I explained everything, didn't I? There was big trouble at work."
"No, I was just wondering the tiniest bit that perhaps you lied out of consideration for me."
"Lied?"
"I feel a bit uneasy about the thought that perhaps you were sitting at home all alone, staring at the dinner you made going cold."
Perhaps that's a rude way to put it, making her look pathetic in order to poke fun at her.
But…
"Yeah, I did tell lies like that… in the past."
A long, long time ago…
The lies Setsuna would tell for my sake would only hurt me later on, and it would only drive Setsuna further into despair.
"But I don't tell lies like that anymore. I don't have to, after all."
"Yeah."
And we kept piling mistake after mistake on top of each other.
In order to erase those mistaken worries, we'd swear a mistaken vow instead.
We made promises we couldn't afford to break in our obsessive attempt to tie each other down, because those promises would tear us apart if ever broken.
"But still, I did have a slight desire to pin all the blame on you."
"Blame…?"
"Dinner slowly growing colder… Waiting in vain for a phone call from my husband… The growing unease of a patient wife…"
"What? I did call you, didn't I? I apologized with my head on the ground!"
"Huh, did you actually kneel down on the ground?"
"You should've seen it… Sincerity was practically oozing out of my entire body."
That's why in the end, we righted all wrongs.
We make promises that we can't afford to break, and when that promise is broken…
Nothing happens. We remain ourselves, just like we swore to… No, it's more like something that kind of just happened on its own.
"Well, no point in chatting in a place like this, let's go."
"Right. Let's call for a taxi…"
"Hey, Haruki-kun… It's a long way home, so how about we drop by a hotel instead?"
"Huh? Are you sure there are rooms available? I mean, today is…"
Today is Christmas Eve. The day lodgings like these get the most business.
"Look, the fabled six hours are nearing their end. People should be checking out about now."
"Yeah, but are you going to look for a hotel now? What are you going to do, call them one by one?"
"Hehehehe, the truth is…"
"Setsuna, don't tell me you…"
"There's a place just behind us. I called them just earlier and apparently they have a single room remaining."
"So anyway, I had to take the opportunity. I've already reserved it for us…"
"…We've both got work tomorrow, you know?"
"We can just hit the sack if you're sleepy. I can hold back for the night."
"No! Absolutely not! I won't be able to hold back!"
"Hehehehe… Well, that's that, then."
We will probably continue to make the same promise every year from now.
We'll do our best to keep it, but at times, we'll be forced to break it.
But then we'll immediately make up, and we'll forget all about it the day after, never using it against each other.
That's how we'll spend Christmas, Setsuna's birthday, and my birthday from now on.
"Oh well, you should at least be able to get two hours of sleep once we're done. Let's hurry!"
Of course, I didn't get a wink of sleep. That was never an option from the beginning.
